title: Acclaimed Shonen Jump Original Returns With New Look At Beloved Characters Amid Anime Delay
content: Written and illustrated by Katsura Hoshino, the beloved D.Gray-man manga debuted in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2004 but eventually faced numerous hiatuses due to her poor health. In 2018, the manga moved to a quarterly schedule in Shueisha’s Jump SQ. Rise , leading to a far slower trickle of new chapters.
author: ComicBook

title: Bandai Namco Filmworks Reveals 'Sunrise 50th Anniversary' Project Including 6 Short Film Projects
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks launched on Wednesday the " Sunrise 50th Anniversary" project to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Muteki Chōjin Zambot 3 , the first work under the Sunrise brand, in 2027. The " Sunrise 50th Anniversary" project will run from 2026 to 2028.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action 'Tonight, I Have a Date with a Serial Killer' Series' Trailer Reveals Theme Song
content: The official X/Twitter account for the live-action series of Kon Iguchi and Yūji Nakamura 's Tonight, I Have a Date with a Serial Killer ( Konya mo Serial Killer to Machiawase ) manga began streaming a new trailer for the series on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Isabella Bird in Wonderland - Unbeaten Tracks in Japan Manga Ends on September 15
content: The manga entered its final arc in April 2024. The manga offers a look at Japanese culture from the eyes of female British adventurer Isabella Bird, who traveled from Tokyo to Ezo (the area now known as Hokkaido) in the early Meiji era.
author: ANN

title: Samurai Deeper Kyo's Akimine Kamijyō Launches New KILLER+SITTER Manga
content: Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine announced on Wednesday that Akimine Kamijyō will launch a new series titled KILLER+SITTER in this year's 30th issue on June 24. The magazine teases the series as a "new era family drama" involving the strongest ex-soldier.

title: Eden of Witches Manga Ends in Next Chapter on August 12
content: The 135th issue of Kadokawa 's Harta magazine revealed on Monday that Yumeji 's Eden of Witches ( Majo no Eden or L’Éden des sorcières ) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on August 12.

title: Kagurabachi Might Have Already Revealed How Long New Anime Will Be
content: Kagurabachi will be making its highly anticipated anime debut next year, but the newest teaser for the series might have already revealed how long the debut season is going to be sticking around for.

title: Gundam’s Owners Might Be in Trouble, According to New Report
content: Mobile Suit Gundam returned to theaters earlier this year by expanding on Hathaway’s Flash storyline, returning to the universe that kicked off the franchise long after Amuro and Char’s war.

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Announces New English Voice Cast
content: Sega announced on Tuesday the English cast for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game. Nazeeh Tarsha plays the Protagonist, previously voiced by Johnny Yong Bosch in the franchise. Paul Castro Jr. plays Yosuke Hanamura, previously voiced by Yuri Lowenthal in the series.
